title: r2c.plugin/v1
description: Payload manifest (`r2c-plugin.json` inside r2c-plugin-<V>.tgz). `version` is the lock-step package version, `engine` is ^V and must equal every adapter.json requires.engine, and `files` maps every payload path to its sha256. The container is ustar+gzip with no links, no PAX and paths <= 100 bytes.

engine.description: ^<version>; compared byte for byte against each adapter.json requires.engine.

files.description: Payload-relative POSIX path -> sha256, in codepoint order. The manifest itself is not listed.
